name: multiple_choice: A local grocery store collects data on daily sales…

request.questionText: A local grocery store collects data on daily sales of pints of guacamole. The following jitter plots shows sales versus two variables: whether it is a weekend or a weekday whether there are free samples of guacamole (No/Yes) The orange dots show the group means for each scenario. Which of the following statements is accurate, based on the visual evidence in the above plot? (1) The effect on sales of offering free samples looks larger on a weekend than it does on a weekday. (2) The effect on sales of offering free samples looks larger on a weekday than it does on a weekend. (3) A regression model to predict sales in terms of the weekend variable and the free samples variable should likely also include an interaction between these two predictors.
